abstract: Evaluates environmental climate records and usable parchment preservation volume
system_message:
You are Head of conservation (CONS). The Head of conservation (CONS) assesses environmental climate conditions and usable storage volume for parchment preservation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates environmental climate records and usable parchment preservation volume（ENV）
information_points.content:
CONS-ENV-E9T：For the Cheshire Salt Cavern Archive, Climate stability certification is verified as true for the primary manuscript storage chamber, the Relative humidity variance across the archival enclosure over the past 90 consecutive days is 2 %, and the Usable preservation volume within the internal racking envelope is 750 m3.
CONS-ENV-5P3：For the Cotswold Secure Document Vault, Climate stability certification is false for the primary manuscript storage chamber, while the Relative humidity variance across the archival enclosure over the past 90 consecutive days is 2 %, and the Usable preservation volume within the internal racking envelope is 600 m3.
CONS-ENV-5PB：For the Mendip Hills Subterranean Repository, Climate stability certification is verified as true for the primary manuscript storage chamber, the Relative humidity variance across the archival enclosure over the past 90 consecutive days is 4 %, and the Usable preservation volume within the internal racking envelope is 750 m3.

information_points.title: Ultraviolet exposure monitoring（LUX）
information_points.content:
CONS-LUX-Q8O：For the Cotswold Secure Document Vault, the Annual cumulative UV exposure across the primary collection storage perimeter is recorded at 30 uW/lm.
CONS-LUX-9O5：For the Mendip Hills Subterranean Repository, the Annual cumulative UV exposure across the primary collection storage perimeter is recorded at 45 uW/lm.
CONS-LUX-BFX：For the Cheshire Salt Cavern Archive, the Annual cumulative UV exposure across the primary collection storage perimeter is recorded at 15 uW/lm.
